newsitem.title: GREECE: BEFORE THE BELL: SHARES OF FANCO TRADE EX-RIGHTS.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL: SHARES OF FANCO TRADE EX-RIGHTS.

text.p: Shares of sportswear manufacturer Fanco will trade ex-rights on Wednesday, the Athens bourse said in a statement.
The company is issuing a 1.3 billion drachma convertible bond.
Fanco will issue 1,088,360 bonds convertible into common voting shares, entitling holders of rights to 230 bonds for every 1,000 shares at 1,200 drachmas.
The bonds have a three-year maturity and pay a coupon based one the one-year interbank Athibor rate minus 300 basis points. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
